title: Chapter 462 Liberate The World
content:
Chapter 462 Liberate The World

Lu Xue pursed her lips and stopped asking.

Her mother has always been inclined to herself, but this time this time the situation did not happen, which made her a little strange.

Unexpectedly, my mother actually had something more important.

Lu Daosheng looked around the audience, and everyone's faces were filled with a little fatigue and absentia, but more because of the excitement after the victory.

Especially the people in the Chaos Realm, they looked at Lu Daosheng with dazzling light in their eyes.

Is this the city lord who created the deserted city in the legend?

It is indeed a legendary existence. With just a slight move, it directly solved the land of the gods that troubled the Chaos Realm and even forced them into desperate situations.

For so long, Lu Daosheng has been paying attention to the situation in the Chaos Realm, and he has also seen everyone's efforts.

But sometimes, if you want to solve the difficulties, simple efforts are not omnipotent.

Just like this time the Chaos Realm.

Facing a land of gods that are countless times stronger than you, it cannot be solved by the efforts of the creatures in the Chaos Realm.

Similarly, facing the desolate city, even if the land of the gods is managed for eight lifetimes, it will never be as good as the desolate city.

A mountain is higher than a mountain.

As the highest peak in the world, Lu Daosheng would probably not have any worries if he hadn't been concerned about it.

Fortunately, he has basically solved the problem of world destruction.

"Let's go, let's go home."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, pulled Lu Xue to his side, and waved his hand slightly, leading everyone present to disappear from the spot.

In the Chaos Realm.

Since the collapse of the Land of Gods, the Chaos Realm has fallen into a brief rejoicing.

They seemed to have won the battle.

But reason told everyone that they would only truly know the end of the war when Lord Lu Xue and the others came back.

And if Lu Xue and others cannot come back, the result will be unimaginable.

In the deserted city, the master of the formation, Qingyang, had a slightly condensed face, staring at the void, and checked the Chaos Combined Strike Formation from time to time, for fear of any accident.

As long as this formation is still there, they still have hope of counterattack.

Lord Lu Xue, you can’t lose.

Zhen Qingyang sighed in his heart, if the city lord was there, there would be no need to be so troublesome.

The city lord is good at everything, but he is too lazy. He always stands by and watches on the grounds of relying on himself.

You don't even look at this land of gods. Is your daughter able to deal with this?

Your good daughter is almost ruined by you.

Of course, Zhen Qingyang just dared to recite these words silently in his heart and did not dare to say them.

At this time, in the deserted city, the Tianjiao List and the combat power list are still operating normally, but now, the role of these two lists does not seem to be that important.

"I don't know how Senior Lu Xue and the others are doing?"

Bai Ling stopped not far outside the Tianjiao List, and his delicate little face was filled with worries.

Seeing his sister's worried look, Bai Xu grinned, patted Bai Ling on the shoulder, and chuckled, "Sister, don't worry too much, you must trust Senior Lu Xue and the others."

"Even if they really lose, aren't we still there?"

"We?" Bai Ling blinked and looked at his brother.

With their current strength, they are not even as good as cannon fodder on the battlefield.

But Bai Xu raised his neck and said, "The Four Eight Symbols of the Four Elephants of our Heavenly Demons has not been used yet. Senior Hao said that once the Four Elephants of the Four Elephants of the World is activated, it is comparable to the peak of the combat power of the Chaos Realm. The existence of

When he said this, Bai Xu had a hint of pride on his face.

The peak of combat power in the Chaos Realm is the Supreme Immortal-grade Heaven? With that kind of strength, even if it cannot change the situation of the battle, it still has the ability to participate in the war.

Listening to Bai Xu's beautiful fantasy, Xuan Si and Qinghai were both silent.

Not only them, but the creatures who did not have the strength to go to the battlefield in the entire deserted city were all in a solemn atmosphere at this moment.

Only a few people have a good attitude like Bai Xu.

On the other side of the square, there was no trace of shadow huddling in the corner, looking as shameless.

He has completed a counterattack this time and has reached the top ten of the Tianjiao List, which has caused a lot of sensation, but now the situation is critical, he is not at all happy.

Looking up at the sky, I had no trace of shadows and expressionless faces, but I felt a little sad.

Facing the first wave of army in the Land of Gods, many of their Shadow Clan members died.

He was still too optimistic in the face of an unknown war.

War is so cruel.

However, sadness is only a small part, and there is more in my heart, and I am still a little relieved.

Their Shadow Clan are not people who live in vain.

"If I had been a few years earlier, I might have been lucky enough to participate in this extraordinary battle."

Ying Wuzhi murmured in his heart, then suddenly became stunned.

I actually had this kind of thought. If his father knew about it, I would probably verify whether this was his own.

And at this moment, a sudden wave swept across the entire Chaos Realm.

At this moment, all living beings looked up at the sky.

I saw that above the sky, the space fluctuated, like the rippling water surface, with waves ripples.

At this moment, the hearts of sentient beings beating to their throats, staring at the sky without blinking.

The moment that determines the fate of the entire Chaos Realm has come.

If the people from the Chaos Realm came, then everyone would be happy.

But if they are powerful people in the other world in the land of the gods, then they can only fight to the death.

In full view of everyone, a man with extraordinary temperament easily passed through the barriers outside the boundary and stepped into the chaos realm in one step.

Meeting this man.

All the creatures in the Chaos Realm were stunned. They felt the aura of a man. They were indeed humans, but why didn't they recognize them?

However, although most creatures in the Chaos Realm do not recognize it, the people in the Desert City were ecstatic and excited.

"It's the city lord! It's the city lord!!"

A man from Huangcheng jumped up on the spot, pointing at Lu Daosheng's excitement and his voice was trembling.

The rest of the people also burst into strong cheers.

"It's really the Lord of the City, really!"

"The city lord has come forward, it seems that it has been solved!"

"Tianyou Chaos Realm!"

When the other creatures in the Chaos Realm heard this, they were also ecstatic after a brief shock.

It was actually the legendary Lord of the Desert City. Even the legendary Lord of the Desert City appeared. That means that the land of the gods has been solved.

Thinking of this, the entire Chaos Realm all bowed to Lu Daosheng together.

"We wait, welcome the return of the Lord of the Huangcheng City!"

Above the deserted city, Zhen Qingyang looked at Lu Daosheng's familiar figure, his eyes were wet and his eyebrows were smiling, "It's considered to be back, it's really not easy."

In the void, Lu Daosheng walked leisurely in the garden, strolling alone, walking towards the direction of the deserted city.

In just a moment, Lu Daosheng came to the sky above the deserted city and stood in the center of the Chaos Realm.

Looking at the exquisitely constructed chaotic attack array, Lu Daosheng looked at the chaotic Qingyang with appreciation, stretched his arms out, and soon, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded in the ears of sentient beings.

"Everyone, we won."

Hearing this, the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm burst into tears and then cheered.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng's words came again.

“But it’s not the end, it’s the beginning.”

"In the numerous worlds, there are countless worlds that are being invaded and enslaved. They may be the land of the gods, or perhaps some other force."

"What I want to do in Huangcheng is to liberate all the worlds, and let your destiny be controlled by yourself!"

The passionate voice kept echoing, and the next moment, near Lu Daosheng, familiar figures emerged, reflecting in the vision of all living beings.
